01 / ABOUT

Intelligence is useful
when it works in the world.

I’m Muhammed Ahsan, an AI engineer and software developer studying Artificial Intelligence at The Islamia University of Bahawalpur.

My work connects machine learning experiments with practical software: inspection tools, AI web applications and systems built for a client’s everyday operations.

I’m particularly interested in computer vision and the data behind it. Alongside development, I curate public datasets and contribute to research on model evaluation.

CLIENT PROJECT / END-TO-END SOLO DEVELOPMENT

The Blend.

02
COMPUTER VISION / INDUSTRIAL INSPECTION

Steel Defect Vision

A YOLOv8s inspection application combining NEU-DET and GC10-DET data. Supports single-image and batch inspection, adjustable detection thresholds and annotated outputs.

PYTHON · YOLOV8 · STREAMLIT

COMPUTER VISION / MANUFACTURING

PCB Defect Detection

A browser-based inspection tool for six PCB manufacturing defect types, using YOLOv8s and DeepPCB. Includes visual summaries, configurable thresholds and CSV reports.
